AND (p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

SELECT p.*, u.username, u.avatar as user_avatar FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.is_pinned DESC, p.created_at DESC
SELECT p.*, u.username, u.avatar as user_avatar FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (user_id, title, content, images, likes_count, comments_count, status, is_pinned, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{images}, 0, 0, 1, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, images = #{images}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE posts SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE posts SET likes_count = likes_count + #{delta} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE posts SET comments_count = comments_count + #{delta} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE posts SET is_pinned = #{isPinned}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: UPDATE posts SET status = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT u.id as userId, u.username, u.avatar, COUNT(p.id) as postCount FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.created_at >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01') AND p.created_at < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY p.user_id, u.id, u.username, u.avatar ORDER BY postCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
